title: Research method for Cardiometabolic trait effector gene predictions (Gloudemans et al., 2022)
bodyHtml:
These results were generated in the study:

Integration of genetic colocalizations with physiological and pharmacological perturbations identifies cardiometabolic disease genes.
Gloudemans MJ, Balliu B, et al.
Genome Med. 2022 Mar 15;14(1):31. doi: 10.1186/s13073-022-01036-8.
PMID: 35292083

This study prioritized candidate causal genes at genetically associated loci for 9 cardiometabolic traits. Genetic associations were derived from the following studies:

Trait GWAS Dataset name in the Knowledge Portals
Fasting insulin Manning AK, Hivert M-F, Scott RA et al., 2017 MAGIC 2012 fasting glucose and insulin GWAS
Fasting glucose Manning AK, Hivert M-F, Scott RA et al., 2017 MAGIC 2012 fasting glucose and insulin GWAS
Insulin sensitivity Walford G, Gustafsson S, Rybin D et al., 2016 MAGIC modified Stumvoll ISI GWAS
Insulin sensitivity index Knowles JW et al., 2015 GENESIS GWAS
Type 2 diabetes Mahajan A et al., 2018 DIAMANTE (European) T2D GWAS
Type 2 diabetes Suzuki K et al., 2019 BioBank Japan GWAS
Type 2 diabetes Spracklen C, Horikoshi M, Kim YJ, Lin K et al., 2020 AGEN and DIAMANTE T2D GWAS
Type 2 diabetes Xue A et al., 2018  
Triglycerides Klarin D et al., 2018  
HDL cholesterol Klarin D et al., 2018  
BMI Yengo L et al., 2018 GIANT UK Biobank GWAS
Waist-hip ratio Pulit SL et al., 2019 GIANT-UK Biobank GWAS Meta-analysis

 

Genetically associated variants were colocalized with eQTLs and sQTLs (GTEx v8) in subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue, liver, skeletal muscle, and pancreas using a custom integration of the FINEMAP and eCAVIAR methods (Gloudemans M, Github). Differential expression of uniquely colocalized genes was assayed in human adipocytes, hepatocytes, and skeletal muscle cells treated with 21 physiological and pharmacological cardiometabolic regulators.

Protein-protein interaction networks were defined for protein-coding genes that were differentially expressed in the presence of a cardiometabolic regulator, using interaction data from the BioGRID database. Interactions were also identified between candidate causal genes and a curated list of known insulin resistance (IR) or T2D causal genes. In the effector prediction table, "primary" in the "Protein-protein interactions" column indicates a direct interaction between the candidate causal gene product and a known IR or T2D causal gene, while "secondary" indicates interaction via one intermediary protein.

The "Direction of effect" columns indicate, for eQTL colocalizations, whether the effect of the eQTL on expression and the effect of the GWAS signal on the trait risk or level are in the same or opposite directions.
